_doc: Manual metadata overrides for archive files that don't appear in the @armeniaca15 X scrape. Merged into public/data/img-archive-mapping.json by scripts/enrich-x-archive.js. Add new entries by file name; nulls stay null. eventName/eventDate filled here win over (the missing) auto-detected values; tweetUrl can also be set if you find the source post on a different account.
_format: Each entry mirrors the mapping JSON: { eventDate: 'YYYY-MM-DD' | null, eventName: string | null, tweetUrl: string | null, source: string (where you got this from), notes: string }
